notes: This contract pins the private composition preflight's executable checks for the IEEE 1516.2-2025 array cardinality syntax and the predefined one-dimensional encoding compatibility rule. It accepts incomplete DIF rows by skipping an omitted cardinality, accepts nonnegative scalar, Dynamic, and nonnegative [lower..upper] components in a comma-separated cardinality list, and pairs HLAfixedArray with fixed cardinality or HLAvariableArray with varying cardinality. Multidimensional and provider-defined encodings remain outside this bounded slice. This is source/test traceability only, not a complete OMT conformance result.
